definition: all the people who work for a company, industry, or country
example: Automation is expected to change a large part of the workforce in the next decade.

definition: the rate at which a person or company produces work or output
example: Remote work has been shown to increase productivity for many employees.

definition: the situation of losing a job because it is no longer needed
example: The company announced hundreds of redundancies after the factory closed.

definition: a system that lets employees choose their own working hours within agreed limits
example: Flexitime allows parents to adjust their schedule around school hours.

definition: a state of physical or mental exhaustion caused by long-term stress, especially from work
example: Long working hours without breaks can eventually lead to burnout.

definition: a skill or certificate that shows someone is suitable for a job or course of study
example: A university degree is often a basic qualification for this type of job.

definition: a person who starts and runs their own business, taking on financial risk
example: Young entrepreneurs are increasingly starting businesses straight out of university.

definition: a healthy balance between the time spent working and the time spent on personal life
example: Remote work has helped many employees achieve a better work-life balance.

definition: the act of raising someone to a higher rank or position at work
example: She received a promotion after five years at the company.

definition: to give a task or responsibility to another person, often someone more junior
example: Good managers know how to delegate tasks effectively.

definition: to work together with others on a task or project
example: Employees from different departments collaborated on the new project.

definition: payment or reward for work or services
example: The job offers good remuneration, including bonuses and health benefits.

definition: working for yourself and taking on jobs for different clients, rather than being employed by one company
example: More people are choosing freelance work for greater flexibility.

definition: the ability to do something well or successfully
example: The training program is designed to build employees' technical competence.

definition: the likelihood that a person will keep their job without the risk of becoming unemployed
example: Many workers value job security more than a higher salary.
